title: bug: an architect's exit checkpoint lands the live assignee's in-flight bytes for the task it planned, so the worker's completion is NOTHING_TO_COMMIT and the DONE task has no completion commit
description:
Observed 2026-10-25 by governor-187cc44e on CQ-I01 task-96526848b23549cf994ab82f47fad29f.

Timeline:
- Codex architect-473624b4's session (pre-flight 09:51:54Z) claimed I01 at pre-flight. It planned I01 at 09:58:13; TURBO auto-approved it to WORKING.
- worker-9cda703c claimed I01 at 09:58:22 and worked steps 1-6. Step 6 started at 10:09:43 and completed at 10:14:37.
- At 10:13:23 the architect session exited. Its wrapper landed checkpoint 263e9f5, `wip(task-96526848…) [status=WORKING role=architect]`, which held the worker's in-flight source bytes: docs/MCP_SERVER.md, server/WebSocketServer.ts, server/WebSocketServer.test.ts and server/clientCapabilities.ts (+412/-12).
- The worker's completion at 10:17:12 returned MOE_COMMIT_NOTHING_TO_COMMIT.
- qa_approve at 10:59:26 raised ⚠️ NO-COMPLETION-COMMIT. task.landing is null on a DONE task whose bytes ARE on the branch. A governor has to reconstruct this by hand every time.

Same shape: 1f9c7d5 (architect-6e3edf85's exit checkpoint on WORKING task-5f3960df).

Cause: the wrapper lands its session's pre-flight task at exit even after that task moved to another live assignee. getCommitScope.ts says there is no ownership guard; orphan mode exists for crash recovery. Interactive architects exit often through the account-switch mod, so this keeps happening.

Effects:
- Mid-edit worker bytes get committed and pushed as a wip under the wrong role, which can break the branch at that commit.
- The completion commit goes missing, along with landing metadata and the Moe-Contested trailer evidence.
- False NO-COMPLETION-COMMIT alarms.

Expected: a session that is not the task's assignee, while the assignee is live or holds an open attempt, lands no source path for that task. It may still land the task's own board record. The bytes stay dirty for the assignee's own landing. Orphan recovery is unchanged when the assignee is dead or absent.

Files: scripts/moe-agent.sh and scripts/moe-agent.ps1 (twins), scripts/tests/postflight.sh and .ps1, and possibly packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/getCommitScope.ts (expose the assignee's liveness). The wrapper and postflight files are currently contested by the stale task-07474ee438f34021a23809f9c764d15c. Plan for a Claude Edit/Write seat, or wait for that contest to clear. Serialize behind task-c532d223459b4ef4b5bab2ba0eb4005e and task-5c71dff9ff2a488d8f75ec375c4f99f8, which edit moe-agent.sh.
definitionOfDone: A non-assignee session exit (architect/QA/governor) on a task whose assignee is a live worker, or holds an open execution attempt, lands no source path for that task. The skip is reported with a named code and through record_commit. The assignee's own later completion commits those bytes, so the task gets a completion commit and landing metadata.
Orphan recovery is unchanged: when the assignee is dead or absent, or the task is unassigned, the existing checkpoint landing still happens. The sh and ps1 wrappers behave identically.

The postflight harness has a case for each behavior in both postflight.sh and postflight.ps1, and bash scripts/tests/parity-check.sh passes. If the daemon is touched, cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test exits 0.
scripts/CLAUDE.md 'Land on every exit' documents the live-assignee rule.

implementationPlan.description: Read landed prerequisites, producer assigneeProtected contract, original DoD and baseline ownership memories. Map every path that can collect live working-tree bytes: run_landing/Invoke-MoeLanding, recovery re-entry, teardown_rescue/Invoke-MoeRescueRef, and any precomputed scope passed into them. Do not edit daemon/shared fake proxy in this task. Confirm source-changing paths all funnel through the guard while receipt replay of an already-landed immutable commit remains unchanged.

Use test-driven-development to add compact equivalent postflight scenarios in both harnesses, using the producer's shared fake-proxy controls. Matrix: own assignee allowed; foreign architect/QA/governor vs protected owner refused (include protection true with presence false to represent quiet/open-attempt owner); dead/missing owner with protection false and explicitly unassigned task still checkpoint; foreign owner with omitted/malformed protection refuses. Protected exit must log/record named refusal, create no source commit/rescue/push, leave source hash/dirty status and baseline header/content unchanged, and preserve shared index. In a sequential same-repo scenario, first foreign exit refuses, then rightful worker completion includes the source bytes and reports committed completion/ref/paths instead of nothing; verify ledger completion shape consumed by landing metadata. Cover daemon-failure/disk fallback and teardown after refusal so a signal cannot recover protected bytes. Keep existing orphan/recovery scenarios intact and update counts only for genuinely added cases.

Implement equivalent fail-closed ownership decisions in both wrapper scope readers/landing paths. Validate task identity and assignedWorkerId; own caller may land, explicit unassigned may land, a different owner may land only when authoritative assigneeProtected is boolean false. Different owner with true refuses using MOE_COMMIT_REFUSED_ACTIVE_ASSIGNEE; missing/malformed/unreadable protection or ownership refuses with MOE_COMMIT_REFUSED_OWNER_UNKNOWN. Error handling: RPC failure or old daemon lacking the field must not be coerced into false; disk fallback may only allow a positively identified own/unassigned task, never infer a foreign owner dead. Refresh cached preflight scope before source landing. Place guard before attribution, baseline pruning/landed marking, branch peel, private-index build and source rescue; ensure teardown/recovery cannot bypass it, including signal cleanup and prebuilt working-tree candidates. Refuse the whole landing (board-only is optional and intentionally omitted), send record_commit outcome refused with task/session/role/code, set existing summary/handled flags so cleanup does not retry; report ledger failure best-effort without mutating Git or losing bytes. Keep owned immutable receipt replay/finalization behavior and orphan checkpoint logic unchanged.

Update scripts/CLAUDE.md 'Land on every exit': former assignee sessions cannot land source while a different owner is protected by registration/open attempt; stale display presence is not proof of death. Document both refusal codes, no source or board landing on guard refusal, unchanged bytes/baseline for owner/recovery, conservative old-daemon/error handling and unchanged dead/absent/unassigned recovery when authoritative metadata permits. Cross-check producer MCP contract and both launcher behaviors; no edits to generated/.moe docs.

Single final verification gate, from a stable exact-candidate checkout/snapshot root with native Windows PowerShell 5.1 and pwsh7 executables on PATH (Git Bash, or Windows-mounted WSL snapshot with correct native cwd): bash -n scripts/moe-agent.sh && MOE_POSTFLIGHT_TIMEOUT_SEC=180 bash scripts/tests/postflight.sh && bash scripts/tests/parity-check.sh && powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command '$ErrorActionPreference="Stop"; $env:MOE_POSTFLIGHT_TIMEOUT_SEC="180"; $tokens=$null; $errors=$null; [void][System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile((Resolve-Path ./scripts/moe-agent.ps1),[ref]$tokens,[ref]$errors); if($errors.Count){throw "PowerShell syntax errors"}; & ./scripts/tests/postflight.ps1; if($LASTEXITCODE){exit $LASTEXITCODE}; & ./scripts/tests/parity-check.ps1; exit $LASTEXITCODE' && pwsh.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command '$ErrorActionPreference="Stop"; $env:MOE_POSTFLIGHT_TIMEOUT_SEC="180"; $tokens=$null; $errors=$null; [void][System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile((Resolve-Path ./scripts/moe-agent.ps1),[ref]$tokens,[ref]$errors); if($errors.Count){throw "PowerShell syntax errors"}; & ./scripts/tests/postflight.ps1; if($LASTEXITCODE){exit $LASTEXITCODE}; & ./scripts/tests/parity-check.ps1; exit $LASTEXITCODE' && (cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test). Run it fresh in a clean test environment without unrelated seat account/session overrides; no PASS-by-SKIP. Both native harnesses, Bash harness/parity and full daemon suite must exit 0. Preserve source hashes/tested root and output summaries; supply command/exitCode/outputTail to complete_task. Do not run full suites after each implementation step.

Final adversarial self-review (adversarial-self-review skill) of producer plus wrapper diffs: assignment changes after preflight, protected owner quiet or missing worker record but open attempt, foreign closed attempt, malformed/null/string booleans, RPC exceptions, concurrent source edits, baseline owned by another session, signals/refusal cleanup and shared index. Check all working-tree rescue entrances honor the same predicate and no refusal marks a foreign baseline landed, closes its attempt or reports a phantom committed row. Confirm own completion and orphan recovery still land; audit actual modified paths versus intended landing. State the residual cross-process scope-read/CAS timing limitation rather than claiming atomic daemon/Git authorization. Any review fixes require the identical final gate again before complete_task.

comments.content: Both existing prerequisites are DONE and landing.merged=true; stale wrapper-conflict task-07474ee4 is ARCHIVED. Source exploration found get_commit_scope already has assigneeAlive (presence only), but no open-attempt protection. To keep this task at five files (both wrappers, twin postflight harnesses, scripts/CLAUDE.md), task-9a9b46d88ff244759570c323ac3a67a4 was created in BACKLOG for additive assigneeProtected + daemon tests/docs + shared fake-proxy controls/tests. This task remains the final integration/hardening gate with original DoD intact and dependsOn gates work. Protection means registered non-DEAD owner regardless of idle timestamp OR matching open attempt. Non-assignee source landing fails closed on missing/malformed protection metadata; refusal skips the entire landing (optional board-only landing is unnecessary), preserving bytes/baseline. @governor-96f92f36 Please surface the producer prerequisite for human promotion. The worker-type wrapper task now depends on this row to serialize shared wrapper edits.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: Root-cause fix is at all wrapper source-landing entrances, not a special-case architect role check or relaxed completion metadata. Optional board-only landing is not required: refusing the entire foreign-owner landing is simpler and preserves recovery state. Additive daemon signal/fake proxy controls are split into prerequisite task-9a9b46d88ff244759570c323ac3a67a4 (BACKLOG); this task retains original DoD and is final integration/hardening for the split. Existing symlink/hot-reload prerequisites are DONE with merged landing. Worker-type task bdf6db6f now depends on this task for wrapper serialization.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights: getCommitScope.ts already returns assignedWorkerId and assigneeAlive, but assigneeAlive uses the 120s display-presence clock, unsafe as a death test. Producer contract assigneeProtected=true for an existing non-DEAD assigned worker regardless of activity timestamp OR any matching task/assigned-worker attempt in running/finalizing/reconciling; unassigned or dead/missing without matching open attempt false. run_landing obtains scope before attribution; Invoke-MoeLanding obtains it before Resolve-MoeAttribution. teardown_rescue and Invoke-MoeRescueRef have direct attribution paths. Existing baseline_landed_flag/Get-MoeBaselineLandedFlag protect another session's baseline but do not prevent source stealing. record_commit accepts outcome refused and arbitrary named code without schema changes. Existing parity tools compare MOE_COMMIT_* codes automatically.
planningNotes.risks: Safety-critical source attribution merits max effort. Never infer death from timestamps, status display or local PID in cross-WSL/native seats. Preserve baseline contents/landed flag/session and dirty paths on refusal; do not let finally/EXIT rescue bypass it. False/missing/malformed ownership metadata differ; Boolean coercion is unsafe. Existing stale contest 07474ee4 is ARCHIVED, no Claude-only restriction from it. No Git writes by the worker outside isolated harness repos; wrappers own actual landing. Gate full scripts snapshot so concurrent hot-reload edits do not mix versions; native Windows path/PS5.1 BOM and PS7 behavior both required. Candidate freeze/receipt replay of already-landed commits is not new source attribution; do not break it or close a foreign attempt.
